newsitem.title: UK: BRITAIN'S ABBEY EMERGES AS BIDDER FOR CATER ALLEN - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: BRITAIN'S ABBEY EMERGES AS BIDDER FOR CATER ALLEN - PAPER.

text.p: Britain's Abbey National Plc has emerged as the mystery bidder in talks to acquire Cater Allen Holdings Plc for 200 million pounds ($326.9 million), the Sunday Times newspaper reported.
Cater Allen shares surged about 25 percent on June 5 after the UK financial services group said it was in talks that could lead to an offer.
Various groups were mentioned as bidders, the paper said.
"But Abbey National was the bank behind the approach, with Gareth Jones, head of Abbey National's treasury division, leading the negotiations," it said.

"Aside from its traditional role as a discount house -- one of the tiny finance houses that act as a go-between for the Bank of England and the big banks -- Cater Allen has a series of small businesses that would fit neatly with Abbey National's portfolio," the paper said.
In particular, Cater has a successful investment operation based in Jersey, the paper said.
Abbey National could not be reached for comment.
